what: A Vietnamese personalised-gift shop that sells in chat; the author runs its Meta ads. October 2026, three ad groups. Figures reported by the author from the shop's order book and the ad account, reconciled on 3 Nov 2026 (late payments and refunds included). The shop confirms these figures and agreed to publish its book (orders, payments, refunds; anonymised customer ids) next to this file; the ad account's own exports are no longer accessible to the author. Its payments did not go through Paid Signal or PayPal: it shows the gap Paid Signal closes, not a result of using it. 'Net' is revenue after refunds, before product, delivery and payment costs.
source: reported by the author (performance marketer running the shop's Meta ads), with the shop's agreement, anonymised; original ad-account exports not available; order-level book published (1,214 invoices, anonymised customer ids, no names or contacts); totals checked against the shop's own reconciliation workbook, published as merchant-case-workbook-2026-10.xlsx (its 'Doi soat' sheet: 28 of 28 checks match: spend, chats, invoices, first payments, full refunds, duplicates, refunds, net revenue per ad group)
payment: Customers paid by bank transfer (VietQR); an order counts as paid only after the shop's accountant matched the money received to the order code.
attribution: Meta records which ad started each chat; staff write that ad group's code into the order book, then match it against payments and refunds.
period: 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-30 (30 days, as the shop's report)

duplicate_payments.note: refunded in full; never counted as orders or revenue
